# Copilot instructions

Follow the repository-wide guidance in `AGENTS.md`; it is the source of truth for all coding agents.

Load only the task-relevant reference:

- Cross-layer or data-flow work: `docs/architecture.md`
- Endpoint or client contract work: `docs/api-contract.md`
- Test/build changes: `docs/testing.md`
- JavaScript/React conventions: `docs/coding-conventions.md`

Do not duplicate those documents here. Keep financial database contents private and preserve existing API and SQLite contracts.
